'''David Jetter''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Normal tournament (27 January)]] on 27 January 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS w/MANY kessel runs]], according to Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1682">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-28-geoffs-normal-real-reportd1682/ geoffs-normal-real-report], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 28 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-28-geoffs-normal-real-reportd1682/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
